annotations.text:
HOME — what changed

The hero was a full screen of branding before the customer saw a single cafe. It is now four lines, and the cafe card is visible without scrolling.

The stats strip is gone. "50K+ GAMERS / 10+ ACHIVMENT" reads as invented when the site lists one cafe, and it was misspelled. In its place: what is free right now, which you already track and never showed.

CAFE + SEAT — what changed

Four numbered steps down one screen: what, how long, which seat, when.

The seat map is new and it is the point. Bookings now hold a specific machine, so the customer picks it rather than being assigned one. Busy seats are visibly unavailable, so nobody picks a seat that is taken.

PAY — what changed

The QR carries the amount, so there is nothing to type and nothing to get wrong.

The amber note says plainly what happens next. Without a payment gateway the cafe confirms by hand, and a screen that hides that leaves the customer waiting without knowing why. Paying at the counter stays one tap away.

KEPT FROM YOUR SITE

Orbitron for headings, Inter for body.

#ff073a red, #00f0ff cyan, #08080c background, #101016 cards.

24px cards, 999px pill buttons, the red-to-#ff6b7a gradient on Book.

The cyber grid is still there, at about half strength. Three overlapping patterns at once was fighting the content.

WORTH YOUR CHECK

Every price and count here is real: PC 100/hr, 70/30min, 4 PCs, 3 PS5, 2 racing, open till 10 PM.

The 4.8 rating is a placeholder - I did not want to invent a number you would then have to live with.
